Hi holo friends 

I’ve been taking some time to write some additions for holo-wiki

First is on lighting for holography

1 Types of lighting, things to use for lighting a object

2 Apply photography lighting to holography

3 Contrast & dramatic lighting applications

am I missing any thing? 

What things do you use when lighting your objects? 

Second is on holographic zone system 

(this has been on my heart and mind for a long time and have not seen it in any written document from a photographers point of view)

1 how to apply the photographic zone system to holography

2 how tonal control is related to the brightness levels in the recorded fringes, and the range of fringes recorded will effect the contrast range in the final image

3 how to control contrast (tonal range) by lighting or by painted object

4 how to control contrast (tonal range) by reference and object beam ratio

5 how to control contrast (tonal range) by development 

all comment welcome
